items.text: NFC South football has earned a negative reputation over the last few years and Sunday's game between the Panthers and Saints didn't do much to change that, but it did push one of the teams into first place in the race to represent the division in the playoffs.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: It's good to learn from getting punched in the face
items.text: Fernando Mendoza didn't look overmatched early in his first NFL start, but the road got tougher for the Raiders' rookie quarterback over the final three quarters of Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs in Hall of Fame company with a long list of statistical achievements
items.text: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs had another phenomenal game on Sunday, and in his fourth NFL season he has hit a long list of statistical milestones that only Hall of Famers have reached before him.
